design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE fist-size black BEETLE, body resembling dense dark iron. Natural sturdy beetle anatomy, single head, compact chest, rounded elongated elytra split by a central seam, six short strong grounded legs and two understated antennae. No giant doll eyes, horns or face. Black near-matte cuticle with subtly hammered organic unevenness and small raking grey highlights; deep black-gray rather than polished chrome or crystal. It is iron-like alive, not a riveted metal toy or robot. Slight three-quarter top view, entire beetle on a broad plain dry muted umber wood grain surface, dark neutral background softly recedes, no green garden, rock field or room props. Credible low soft lighting reveals dense shell thickness, small contact shadows, subdued light on leg tips. Strong quiet little object, no black magic smoke, runes, armour filigree or obvious qi aura.
